subject: 现存正立面（多期建筑）
author: Rene Heise
source_note: 据2010年照片绘现状多期正立面，非七世纪原貌复原；临时施工告示与前景去除。
prompt: Create one precise Chinese heritage INK LINE DRAWING of the present-day main frontal elevation of the Jokhang Temple (大昭寺) in Lhasa. Image 1 is the actual 2010 subject photograph showing the current multi-period facade; image 2 is the project's delicate black line style sample. Depict the recognizable central golden roof pavilion with tiered roof, finials and deer-and-wheel style rooftop ornaments as observed, the deep red broad Tibetan main wall behind it and low side wings. This is a drawing of the CURRENT COMPOSITE EXTERIOR, not a reconstruction of the 7th-century original. Follow the photo's real geometry, simplify intricate roof ornaments rather than invent script or exact iconography. Exclude the temporary construction banners, foreground potted trees, modern awnings and people. No legible text or invented Tibetan characters. Fine charcoal contour lines, spare architectural joints, no black filled wall masses. Center complete architectural silhouette in landscape 4:3 with generous blank margin. Every exterior background pixel must be flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF; no gray wash, gradient, cast shadow, paper texture, glow, checkerboard or transparency.
